paper.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

result.summary: 本文提出检索增强生成（RAG）模型，将预训练参数记忆（BART）与非参数记忆（Wikipedia 稠密向量索引，经 DPR 检索）结合，并端到端微调 [S1.p2]。作者比较了 RAG-Sequence 与 RAG-Token 两种边缘化方式 [S2.p2]。在多个知识密集型任务上，RAG 在三个开放域问答任务上取得当时最优结果，并在生成任务中比纯参数 BART 更具体、多样和事实准确 [S1.p4]。作者还展示了通过替换非参数记忆索引即可更新模型知识 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修正记忆、无法直接提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。已有结合参数与非参数记忆的模型（如 REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答 [S1.p1]。作者希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型，并探索通用的微调方法 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.

REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
We endow pre-trained, parametric-memory generation models with a non-parametric memory through a general-purpose fine-tuning approach which we refer to as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

method.text: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。检索到的文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，提出 RAG-Sequence（整个序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）两种形式 [S2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。训练时联合微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器，文档编码器与索引保持固定 [S2.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
a retriever $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ with parameters $\eta$ that returns (top-K truncated) distributions over text passages given a query $x$
a generator $p_{\theta}(y_{i}|x,z,y_{1:i-1})$ parametrized by $\theta$ that generates a current token based on a context of the previous $i-1$ tokens
we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable. We propose two models that marginalize over the latent documents in different ways
The RAG-Sequence model uses the same retrieved document to generate the complete sequence.
In the RAG-Token model we can draw a different latent document for each target token and marginalize accordingly.
The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR. DPR follows a bi-encoder architecture
We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
keep the document encoder (and index) fixed, only fine-tuning the query encoder $\text{BERT}_{q}$ and the BART generator.

experiments.text: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source. Following and, we use the December 2018 dump.
Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
build a single MIPS index using FAISS with a Hierarchical Navigable Small World approximation for fast retrieval.
We consider $k\in\{5,10\}$ for training and set $k$ for test time using dev data.
We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.

findings.text: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得当时最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。RAG 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART [S4.SS3.p1]；人工评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更事实准确，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更事实准确 [S4.SS3.p1]。在 FEVER 三分类上，RAG 与当时最优模型的差距在 4.3% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。RAG 生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。通过替换索引，RAG 可更新世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
BART was more factual than RAG in only 7.1% of cases, while RAG was more factual in 42.7% of cases
For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在故事生成等任务中检索组件可能“崩溃”，即无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取证据句子）因使用不同 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，作者希望未来解决 [A5.p1]。此外，作者尝试的“空文档”机制未能提升性能，因此省略 [A6.p1]。

evidence.quote: we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART.
As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
